provenance.description: Four-limb rail ascent from bounded motor torques, with sequential guarded release, advance, recapture and chassis rise. missed-grip
provenance.coordinateConversion: p=(x,z,-y); Rg=C Rm C^T; quaternions xyzw. Local prototype origin: translate all positions together to place on tower.
limitations: Concept robot; 0.45 m links and 137 kg assumed mass.
Ideal point clamps: force reactions, no clamp moments, teeth, latch or strength model.
Rigid world rails; no tower compliance feedback.
Limb/rail and limb/limb collisions disabled; clearance and snagging require separate validation.
No construction payload, beam, crane, battery, sensing or certified control modeled.
